t: striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][1],
stirring up thereby clouds of dust,
plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[1],
indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[1] –
and he himself is a witness to that[1] –
and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.
Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,
and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[1]?
Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[1].
f: [1] i.e., those horses that fight for the cause of Allah as they race to attack the enemy.
[1] While the enemy is unaware of their raid.
[1] i.e., penetrating into the ranks of the enemy as a surprise attack.
[1] disobeying Him by not spending in the cause of Allah from what He has given him and commanded him to spend accordingly.
[1] i.e., when all secrets of the hearts and faiths are made known.
[1] Nothing of their affairs will be hidden from Him.
